title: DramaBox: a run can fail 'tensors on the same device' when VRAM is tight (4-bit Gemma loads outside ComfyUI)
description: Breaks users (paid DramaBox Flow). Seen live 2026-10-01 on Fabio's RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB: DramaBoxTextEncode RuntimeError, mat1 on cuda:0 vs weights on cpu. The 4-bit Gemma loads to the GPU outside ComfyUI's view; ComfyUI then finds 0 MB free and leaves the embeddings processor on the CPU, whose plain nn.Linear cannot run split. Fix in MadPonyInteractive/ComfyUI-MelodramaBox, then repin node_lock.json. Diagnosis in brief.md.
